economy.summary: Her campaign priorities page supports raising the minimum wage and making it easier for entrepreneurs to start and grow businesses, and pledges to address rising childcare costs, healthcare reform, and student debt for working families.
economy.short: Supports raising minimum wage; pledges to address childcare costs, student debt.

abortion.summary: Introduced House Bill 670, a state version of the federal FACE Act, to protect patients and providers at reproductive healthcare facilities from violence, intimidation, obstruction, and harassment, saying all efforts must be made to keep reproductive healthcare readily accessible and to keep patients and providers safe.
abortion.short: Introduced bill protecting access to reproductive healthcare facilities.

education.summary: In an official statement on Pittsburgh Public Schools building closures, including three schools in her district, she said the transition must address students' diverse needs, respond to community concerns, and ensure equitable access regardless of ZIP code or school assignment.
education.short: Says school closure transition must ensure equitable access for students.

healthcare.summary: Co-prime sponsored and voted for House Bill 200, the Family Care Act, which passed the state House and would create a family and medical leave insurance program providing eligible workers up to 12 weeks of partial wage replacement during serious personal or family medical situations.
healthcare.short: Co-sponsored, voted for state paid family and medical leave program.

energy.summary: In a 2024 candidate Q&A she identified flooding as a major problem in the district and called for cross-municipal dialogue and state support for local municipalities addressing it; she has not published a broader energy platform.
energy.short: Names flooding a major district problem; seeks state support, municipal coordination.

guns.summary: Was endorsed in her 2023 special election by CeaseFirePA Action, which said her questionnaire responses committed her to supporting gun violence prevention legislation, safe storage measures, efforts to end illegal firearm trafficking, and investments in community violence intervention programs; her campaign site does not detail a gun position.
guns.short: Endorsed by CeaseFirePA Action after committing to gun violence prevention measures.
